channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kelly Olynyk | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kelly Olynyk from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
This gives Williamson more of an opportunity to make an impact.

“It definitely gives me an advantage because, especially with KO (Olynyk) out there now, because if you stick a small on him, he’s just going to duck in,”

Zion Williamson on Kelly Olynyk, Feb 24, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kyle Filipowski on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
an NBA scout told HoopsHype.

“He’s got a nasty streak to him. He’s got some competitiveness to him on the defensive end. That’ll give him a chance. He’s like Kelly Olynyk, in my opinion.”

Kyle Filipowski on Kelly Olynyk, Sep 6, 2023. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on second unit missing Kelly Olynyk:

“Leadership. Our entire team is missing his offensive leadership and defensive acumen-- what to do and where to be, and his talking on defense.”

Dwane Casey on Kelly Olynyk, Nov 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Saddiq Bey on Isaiah Stewart, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
James Edwards III:Saddiq Bey on the battles between Isaiah Stewart and Kelly Olynyk:

“It's a great battle. Isaiah is a workhorse and Kelly is savvy. It's good to see them battle.”

Saddiq Bey on Isaiah Stewart, Kelly Olynyk, Oct 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Cory Joseph on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
James Edwards III:Cory Joseph on Olynyk:

“Very, very pleased that Kelly landed here. He's been my great friend for a long, long time.”

Cory Joseph on Kelly Olynyk, Sep 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Mason Plumlee, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on what Kelly Olynyk brings:

“Spacing. No disrespect to Mason (Plumlee), they’re different players. Kelly spaces the floor, he’s a great passer.”

Dwane Casey on Mason Plumlee, Kelly Olynyk, Sep 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Kelly Olynyk's recent surge:

“His skill set can help us. It has taken a little bit of time, and unfortunately adversity ... for us to get to this.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kelly Olynyk, Feb 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Hassan on @Kelly Olynyk:

“He’s a great player. He’s a little bit under viewed because he looks like a surfer. But he can definitely play.”

Hassan Whiteside on Kelly Olynyk, Jul 8, 2017. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Green said on his podcast.

“[Olynyk] yanked [Love's] shoulder out of place. I don't roll with that, man. He's just dirty. You know veteran tricks is grabbing an arm so a guy can't get there to block a shot or cutting some guy off so he can't get there to contest. But you're not doing nothing to hurt nobody. This dude [Olynyk] be out there trying to hurt people.”

Draymond Green on Kelly Olynyk, May 9, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Draymond Green on Kevin Love, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Green said on the podcast.

“Knowing all the tricks ain’t doing stuff to hurt people. [Olynyk] yanked [Love’s] shoulder out of place. I don’t roll with that, man. He’s just dirty. You know veteran tricks is grabbing an arm so a guy can’t get there to block a shot or cutting some guy off so he can’t get there to contest. But you’re not doing nothing to hurt nobody. This dude be out there trying to hurt people.”

Draymond Green on Kevin Love, Kelly Olynyk, May 8, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Jay King:Stevens on Olynyk called a dirty player:

“I'm not sure where that narrative starts.... Another guy rushed him and chucked him to the ground”

Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk, May 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Jay King:Isaiah Thomas on Oubre-Olynyk:

“They know who to go at. The whole NBA knows certain players they can targetand certain players they can't.”

Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk, Kelly Oubre, May 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
“[Olynyk] means everything to me because that's another guy that can space the floor and, when he's hitting his shots, it's hard to guard because he has a really great pump fake and he can make plays as well,”

Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk, Mar 10, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Steve Bulpett:Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk:

“He means everything to me because that’s another guy that can space the floor. When he’s playing like that, we usually win.”

Isaiah Thomas on Kelly Olynyk, Mar 9, 2017. Source: Twitter @SteveBHoop.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk:

“They've been working around the clock for Kelly to get back. It's ultimately Kelly's call on that based on how he feels”

Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk, Apr 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Ainge on Kelly Olynyk’s shoulder:

“He’s getting better… We don’t need to do any surgery. There’s no tear. He’s still 2-3 weeks away.”

Danny Ainge on Kelly Olynyk, Feb 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: LeBron James on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Rick Noland:LeBron James on Kelly Olynyk at Q:

“We've already talked about that long ago. It makes no sense for me to build up skeletons.”

LeBron James on Kelly Olynyk, Feb 5, 2016. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Olynyk, a native of Toronto, entered Sunday shooting 44.4 percent from beyond the arc, fifth best in the league.

“[Olynyk] hasn’t said anything to me about it, but I think it would be great,”

Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk, Feb 1, 2016. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Kevin Love on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
“But as far as any animosity or holding any sort of angst towards [Kelly] Olynyk or the Boston Celtics, I don't feel that at all. I think they're all quality people.”

Kevin Love on Kelly Olynyk, Dec 14, 2015. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Kevin Love on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
“Olynyk was in a compromising position, had no chance to get the ball and it’s just too bad that he would go to those lengths to take somebody out of the game and do that to someone. I have no doubt in my mind that he did that on purpose.”

Kevin Love on Kelly Olynyk, Apr 27, 2015. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Doug Collins on Kevin Love, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Chris Fedor:Doug Collins on Love-Olynyk play and Love's comments:

“I think (Love) spoke out of emotion. I don’t think it was an intentional play.”

Doug Collins on Kevin Love, Kelly Olynyk, Apr 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Jalen Rose on Kevin Love, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Chris Fedor:Jalen Rose on Love-Olynyk play:

“I don’t think it was premeditated. There’s a lot of grappling that takes place in basketball games.”

Jalen Rose on Kevin Love, Kelly Olynyk, Apr 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Ben Rohrbach:Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk:

“I think we have to find a way for him to play well w/o being elbowed in the eye every game.”

Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk, Apr 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @brohrbach.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Stevens on Olynyk's return date:

“I would think it would be within a week, but I don't know that.”

Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk, Feb 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Brad Stevens on Olynyk playing in Rising Stars:

“Obviously there’s no way we would want him to do it unless he was 100 percent healthy.”

Brad Stevens on Kelly Olynyk, Jan 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Jeff Green, Courtney Lee, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
“I’ve had a chance to watch them a couple times on TV. Obviously you see their big rookie [Kelly Olynyk]; you see [Jared] Sullinger, he’s taken the next step [and] I think he’s finally healthy; and then when they get Rondo back, this team has a bright future. Jeff Green, I expect him to emerge and really have a good season; Courtney Lee is comfortable out there; Avery [Bradley], it’s time for him to really step up. So they have some nice pieces to build with.”

Paul Pierce on Jeff Green, Courtney Lee, Kelly Olynyk, Oct 16, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.
